Harper Liu: Quick check  KeelWave reserved pool bring-up tomorrow 09:30 PT. Need sign-off on steady vs burst carve, autoscale cooldown, and whether to exclude /batch from bursts. @Ethan Park?
Ethan Park: They committed 50k tokens/min. I suggest 37.5k baseline (75%) + 12.5k burst for first 72h. Exclude /batch and /analytics from burst.
Zoe (CSM): Customer agreed to 25% buffer for 72h if Finance flags it as "bring-up buffer" and not billed as overage. They want a 10-min morning health check and a 20-min enablement after first run.
Ethan Park: I'll run a three-phase soak tonight: 15m prefix priming, 10m steady at baseline, 90s spike to 58k. KV priming included. k6 snippet below for spike phase.
Ethan Park: ```
import http from 'k6/http';
export default function() {
  http.post('https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate', JSON.stringify({model:'rw-dedicated-7b', prompt:'warmup'}), { headers: { 'Authorization':'Bearer $TEST' } });
}
```

Ethan Park: Recommendation on autoscale: aggressive scale-up window 25s, warmup cooldown 50s. If p95 > 280ms for >90s, enable 5% diversion to quantized fallback and soft-throttle /batch.

Harper Liu: Action items: (1) apply 25/75 carve, (2) set autoscale windows per Ethan, (3) soft-throttle /batch during spikes, (4) tag metrics "bringup:KeelWave", (5) daily digest to customer. Assign @Ethan Park + @Zoe (CSM).
Zoe (CSM): Invite sent for enablement and health checks. Posted quick feedback form: https://forms.gle/keelwave-warmup. I'll confirm billing flag with Finance.
Ethan Park: I'll push cooldown + throttle rules and enable the 5% fallback routing. Will monitor first 72h and post daily digests.
Harper Liu: Great  reconvene after 72h for post-mortem and renewal prep. :white_check_mark:
